title: Require Accessibility Style Projections
summary: Added full, reduced, static, narrated, high-contrast, no-depth, keyboard, and rewind gestalt-style projections. Every projection inherits the same causal phase IDs and semantic traversal ranks; reduced/static remove organic expressiveness while retaining checkpoint sampling.
